Semantic Guessing

Similarity ranks generated with Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, the quantized ONNX conversion of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (Apache 2.0), using Transformers.js. Mean-pooled, normalized embeddings are compared with cosine similarity. Ranks are relative to this bundled vocabulary, not all English words.

Guess vocabulary: first 6,000 alphabetic entries from first20hours/google-10000-english (no-swears list), derived from Peter Norvig’s word frequency compilation, plus independently selected secret words. The pack can include names, abbreviations, and inflections. No model runs on your phone and no guesses are uploaded.
